topic: Wedding and festival season: goal-based saving for family events

slides.headline: Celebrate big. Plan early. Stress less.
slides.subhead: Weddings and festivals are goals you can see coming.

slides.title: Plan the celebration, not just the day

points.title: Know the date
points.text: A wedding or festival has a date, so you can plan backward.

points.title: Split it up
points.text: Break the total into a monthly amount you can manage.

points.title: Keep it separate
points.text: Giving each goal its own pot keeps spending clear.

slides.headline: Plan the joy. Enjoy the day.
slides.cta: Save this for your next family plan
slides.footnote: General education. Choose what suits your time frame.

caption: Weddings and festivals come with dates, which means you can plan for them. Break the cost into monthly amounts and give each goal its own pot. #FamilyGoals #WeddingPlanning #FestivalSeason #India #MutualFunds
